title: Synth kit
description: A beginner analog synth kit — VCO, VCF, simple envelope, built from a kit PCB.
vision: Learn basic analog synth building blocks by building one end to end.
timeline: Week 4: calibration + debugging a noisy VCO
insights: The VCO noise turned out to be a bad ground connection, not a bad component — worth checking grounding before swapping parts next time.
nextSteps: Could add a second oscillator for basic FM later.
